subject.title: fix(cron): allow timeoutSeconds: 0 for no-timeout mode

question: Should maintainers keep this contributor PR as the active fix path, or close it in favor of a refreshed replacement from the canonical issue?
rationale: The bug and patch shape are clear, but the branch is conflicting and proof-gated, and ClawSweeper cannot supply contributor real behavior proof or decide whether to adopt a replacement branch.

options.title: Ask for refresh and proof

options.title: Sponsor a replacement

options.title: Close this stale branch
